I'm thinking about converting the attached document instead of this marked down table at the top to a properties concept like a metadata concept because within my second brain in obsidian I can use that if you to aggregate details across different files and I think this would be better way to kind of view the system to be able to piece things apart and and half percentages of guarantees met by some systems and some by others and generally interact with the systems approach better in a more dynamic way

#### Assumptions
- 1MW total system capacity for ~1000 person community
- 150W/m² peak generation capacity
- 4.2 average sun hours per day in Michigan
- 20% capacity factor (accounting for weather, seasonal variation)
- Internal resource unit costs:
  - Electrical infrastructure maintenance: $15k/year
  - Energy storage integration costs included separately
- 25-year panel lifespan, 10-year inverter lifespan
#### Market Solutions $438k/year
Based on standard utility rates for equivalent consumption:
- Energy charges: $365k/year (10,000 kWh/day × $0.10/kWh)
- Demand charges: $48k/year (1MW peak × $4/kW × 12 months)
- Connection fees: $25k/year
#### Labor 2,190 Hours/year
| Task                        | Hours/Year | Notes                                |
| --------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Regular panel cleaning      | 520        | Weekly cleaning during snow season   |
| Snow removal                | 480        | Winter maintenance                   |
| System monitoring           | 365        | Daily checks and data logging        |
| Inverter maintenance        | 240        | Monthly detailed checks              |
| Ground maintenance          | 240        | Vegetation control, access paths     |
| Performance optimization    | 200        | Angle adjustments, efficiency checks |
| General repairs             | 120        | Various repairs and replacements     |
| Data analysis and reporting | 25         | Monthly performance reports          |
| Total labor (hours)         | 2,190      |                                      |
#### Operating Costs $48k/year
| Component                 | External Cost ($) | Internal Cost ($) | Notes                            |
| ------------------------- | ----------------- | ----------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Replacement parts         | $20k              | 0                 | Mainly inverter components       |
| Cleaning supplies         | $8k               | 0                 | Including snow removal equipment |
| Monitoring software       | $6k               | 0                 | Annual licensing                 |
| Grid interconnection fees | $12k              | 0                 | Required for grid-tied system    |
| Internal resources        | 0                 | $2k               | From other community systems     |
| Total annual cost         | $48k              | $2k               |                                  |
#### Initial Costs $2.4M + 9,600 hrs -> $168k + 384 hrs/year
| Component          | Initial Cost ($ + hrs) | Lifespan (Years) | Amortized Cost/Year ($ + hrs) | Justification                         |
| ------------------ | ---------------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Solar panels       | $1.2M + 3,000 hrs      | 25               | $48k + 120 hrs                | 3,333 panels at $360 each             |
| Inverters          | $600k + 2,000 hrs      | 10               | $60k + 200 hrs                | String inverters with optimization    |
| Mounting systems   | $300k + 2,400 hrs      | 25               | $12k + 96 hrs                 | Ground mount with snow load rating    |
| Wiring/electrical  | $200k + 1,600 hrs      | 25               | $8k + 64 hrs                  | Including transformers and protection |
| Monitoring system  | $100k + 600 hrs        | 10               | $10k + 60 hrs                 | Advanced monitoring and controls      |
| Total initial cost | $2.4M + 9,600 hrs      | -                | $168k + 384 hrs               |                                       |
#### System Outputs
| Output Type       | Daily Units | Annual Units  | Internal Cost ($/unit) | Internal Cost (hrs/unit) | Notes                    |
| ----------------- | ----------- | ------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------ |
| Base generation   | 4,200 kWh   | 1,533,000 kWh | $0.031                 | 0.0014                   | Average daily production |
| Peak generation   | 6,000 kWh   | -             | $0.028                 | 0.0012                   | Maximum summer day       |
| Winter generation | 2,400 kWh   | -             | $0.042                 | 0.0018                   | Minimum winter day       |
#### Revenue $150k/year
| Service Category     | Revenue ($) | Notes                                    |
| -------------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Grid export (summer) | $90k        | Excess production during peak generation |
| Demand reduction     | $48k        | Reduced utility demand charges           |
| RECs/Carbon credits  | $12k        | Environmental attribute sales            |
### Technical Details
#### Panel Configuration
- Panel type: High-efficiency monocrystalline
- Panel rating: 300W each
- Total panels: 3,333 for 1MW system
- Panel dimensions: 1.6m × 1m
- Array configuration: 48V strings
- Ground clearance: 0.5m minimum
- Tilt angle: 30° fixed (optimized for latitude)
#### Performance Metrics
- Peak capacity: 1MW
- Average daily production: 4,200 kWh
- Annual production: 1,533,000 kWh
- Capacity factor: 20%
- Performance ratio: 0.8
- Annual degradation rate: 0.5%
#### Maintenance Requirements
- Weekly visual inspections
- Monthly detailed performance analysis
- Quarterly inverter maintenance
- Semi-annual complete system check
- Annual thermographic inspection
- Snow removal as needed (winter)
#### Integration Features
- Grid-tied with anti-islanding
- Remote monitoring and control
- Power quality monitoring
- Smart inverter functions
- Production forecasting
- Load management interface
